items.title: Eat a Fish Bit
items.detail: Fish Bits are crafted at a Cooking Station by processing caught fish.

items.title: Catch a Fish in the Forest Region
items.detail: Fast travel to Deathclaw Island and fish at any water source deep enough.

items.title: Complete an Event or Activity while in a Team
items.detail: Join any team from the Social menu; you can be the only member.

items.title: Cripple a Protectron or a Robobrain's Arm
items.detail: Fast travel to RobCo Research Center; use V.A.T.S. with a rifle.

items.title: Eat a Cobbler, which is not a Pie.
items.detail: Cook a cobbler at a Cooking Station, then eat it; pies do not count.

items.title: Kill an Enemy with any Pistol
items.detail: Craft a 10mm or Pipe Pistol; Wavy Willard's Water Park has many low-level Scorched.

items.title: Sell Bloatfly Meat to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Find Bloatflies at New River Gorge Resort or Super Duper Mart; sell at any vendor.

items.title: Collect a Fuel Tank or Gas Canister
items.detail: Found at industrial and roadside locations like Toxic Larry's Meat 'n Go.

items.title: Complete a Daily Operation!
items.detail: Easier with a team; join a Daily Ops public team and enter the instance.

items.title: Craft any Plushie at a Tinkerer's Bench
items.detail: Use a Tinkerer's Bench at your C.A.M.P. or at Whitespring Resort.

items.title: Cripple a Spooky Scorched's Leg
items.detail: Spooky Scorched appear during the seasonal event; fast travel to Morgantown Airport.

items.title: Drink Nuka-Grape
items.detail: Get from a Nuka-Cola Collectron Station in a C.A.M.P., then drink.

items.title: Drink Nuka-Orange
items.detail: Get from a Nuka-Cola Collectron Station in a C.A.M.P., then drink.

items.title: Kill a Creature
items.detail: Whitespring Golf Club has dense populations of Feral Ghouls inside.

items.title: Kill a Creature while Wearing a Costume
items.detail: Any apparel item with the Costume keyword counts; Poseidon Energy Plant has creatures.

items.title: Take a Chem
items.detail: Get Chems from a Doctor's Orders Cigarette Machine in a C.A.M.P.

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: Spooky Scorched appear throughout Appalachia as Legendary enemies wearing Halloween costumes and masks.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run Weekend
events.description: Increased chance of catching seasonal fish during this weekend event.

events.name: Double SCORE and Caps-A-Plenty
events.description: Earn double SCORE points and increased caps rewards during this event.

events.name: Double XP Weekend
events.description: Gain experience points at double rate during this weekend event.

events.name: Holiday Scorched
events.description: Holiday-themed Scorched enemies appear with special rewards and gifts.
